description: §55.5.2: a `let` validated value that nothing binds but logic writes (a swatch button) is legal; its surface reads invalid at start and valid after the write.
rationale: §55.5.2: "A value set only from logic (a colour chosen by swatch buttons, read through `@accent.isValid` on an \"Apply\" button) is legal, for child fields and top-level values alike".
